elsewhere.note: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
